run_challenge_evaluation: run the NeurIPS challenge evaluation script with a model name and results file to compute ML success rates
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates by comparing predicted energies against DFT ground truth energies
process_ml_data: process ML prediction results from an NPZ file and organize energies by system and configuration ID
get_dft_data: organize released DFT target mapping data into a nested dictionary for evaluation lookup
is_successful: check if a predicted ML energy is within the success threshold of the best DFT energy
